title: Return to Amritsar, Restoration of the Shrine, and Episode 93 Opens

blocks.text: The Khalsa returns toward Amritsar after prayer, travel, and the completion of the Sirhind action. On arrival the Singhs find desecration and damage at the sacred center, a reminder that Mughal hostility has targeted not only Sikh bodies but Sikh space and memory as well.

The response is immediate and collective. The Singhs clear the damage, rebuild what they can, and restored the sacred pool to its original glory, turning physical repair into an act of devotion and institutional renewal at the heart of the Panth.

From this work of restoration the narrative passes into a more solemn register. Episode 93 opens on Bhai Mani Singh, framing him as the saint-scholar whose fidelity to Sikh discipline and sacred responsibility will culminate in martyrdom.
